text: on mobile webgl might need to use device pixel ratio or so. It seems kind of blurry and the TAA jitter is too larger

status.comment: DPR-aware WebGL/TAA rendering is implemented and internally verified; awaiting visual confirmation on a high-density mobile display.

reflection: Confirmed TAA already existed; the blur came from sizing the WebGL framebuffer to CSS pixels. Added DPR-aware framebuffer sizing (capped at 3× to bound GPU memory), resized before TAAPass.begin so TAA attachments match the physical canvas in the same frame, and scaled camera pan/zoom into physical pixels for nodes, arrows, culling, and selection spinner. TAA jitter remains ±0.5 physical pixels because shaders now divide it by the physical viewport. Verification: pixel-ratio unit tests 3/3 pass; frontend vue-tsc passes. Needs visual confirmation on an actual high-DPR/mobile display.
